strings.zh: 吉尔露太『来吧三圣鸟,{NEWLINE}用你们的能量搅乱这里的海流,{CLEAR}让洛奇亚苏醒过来！
strings.en: Lawrence: Come, legendary birds!{NEWLINE}Use your energy to churn up the{CLEAR}currents here and wake Lugia!
strings.notes: Lawrence forces Lugia awake with the legendary birds, catches it with a Special Ball; later Satsuki's Kimono Girls re-summon it with the Tidal Bell (#29–#48).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『吉尔露太是在召唤洛奇亚吗？{NEWLINE}得赶紧阻止他！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Is Lawrence summoning{NEWLINE}Lugia? I have to stop him!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让开！不要在这里碍事！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Out of the way!{NEWLINE}Don’t get in my way here!

strings.zh: 哼,联盟冠军很了不起吗？{NEWLINE}我们火箭队可没义务听你的话！
strings.en: Hmph, so what if you’re the{NEWLINE}League Champion? Team Rocket has{CLEAR}no obligation to listen to you!

strings.zh: 就算我们不是你的对手,{NEWLINE}但为吉尔露太大人争取时间{CLEAR}还是做得到的！
strings.en: We may be no match for you, but we can{NEWLINE}still buy time for Master Lawrence!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没时间了,快把路让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: There’s no{NEWLINE}time! Get out of the way!

strings.zh: 洛奇亚『Luuu——gia！
strings.en: Lugia: Luuu-gia!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈哈,这个穿透力十足的叫声……
strings.en: Lawrence: Ha ha! What a piercing cry...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『吉尔露太！你要干什么！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Lawrence!{NEWLINE}What are you up to?!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哟,你这次来的挺快嘛。{NEWLINE}不过海底的洋流已经被三圣鸟扰乱,{CLEAR}洛奇亚的苏醒无法避免了,哈哈哈！
strings.en: Lawrence: My, you got here quickly{NEWLINE}this time. But the legendary birds{CLEAR}have already disrupted the undersea{CLEAR}currents. Lugia’s awakening{CLEAR}can’t be stopped! Hahaha!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『既然无法避免,{NEWLINE}那我就在洛奇亚出现之前打倒你！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If it can’t be{NEWLINE}stopped, then I’ll take you{CLEAR}down before Lugia appears!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『打倒我？
strings.en: Lawrence: Take me down?

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『火焰鸟、闪电鸟、急冻鸟！
strings.en: Lawrence: Moltres, Zapdos, Articuno!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『我现在可是掌握了{NEWLINE}三圣鸟力量的人,{CLEAR}想赢我可没那么容易！
strings.en: Lawrence: I now command the{NEWLINE}power of the legendary birds.{CLEAR}Beating me won’t be so easy!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『啊……果然还是你更强啊。{NEWLINE}这样看来弄到洛奇亚的力量{CLEAR}真的非常必要。
strings.en: Lawrence: Ah... You’re stronger{NEWLINE}after all. That just shows how{CLEAR}badly we need Lugia’s power.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不要妄想了,只要我在这里,{NEWLINE}你们是没有机会的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t kid yourself. As long{NEWLINE}as I’m here, you don’t stand a chance!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哦？是吗……
strings.en: Lawrence: Oh? Is that so...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈哈哈！洛奇亚现身了！{NEWLINE}这股气势真是令人窒息啊！{CLEAR}三圣鸟在它面前简直就跟小鸡仔一样。
strings.en: Lawrence: Hahaha!{NEWLINE}Lugia has appeared! Its presence{CLEAR}is breathtaking! Next to it, the{CLEAR}legendary birds are like little chicks.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『洛奇亚,已经没事了。{NEWLINE}刚才打扰你的火箭队都被我击败了。{CLEAR}安全起见你还是回到瀑布里面去吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Lugia, it’s all right now.{NEWLINE}I’ve beaten the Team Rocket members{CLEAR}who disturbed you. To be safe, you{CLEAR}should go back behind the waterfall.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『咳……洛奇亚你这是干什么……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ugh... Lugia,{NEWLINE}what are you doing...?

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『嘿嘿,按照传说中的方法,{NEWLINE}要唤醒洛奇亚,{CLEAR}需要羽毛、铃铛和祈祷仪式。{CLEAR}但现在是用扰乱海流的方式{CLEAR}强行唤醒了洛奇亚,{CLEAR}所以它好像很生气呢。
strings.en: Lawrence: Heh heh. The legendary{NEWLINE}way to wake Lugia takes a feather,{CLEAR}a bell and a prayer ritual.{SCROLL}But this time it was forced awake{NEWLINE}by disturbing the currents,{CLEAR}so it seems rather angry.

strings.zh: 洛奇亚『Luuu——gia！{SCROLL}洛奇亚攻击了过来！
strings.en: Lugia: Luuu-gia!{SCROLL}Lugia attacked!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『呼……洛奇亚,{NEWLINE}拜托你冷静下来好吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Phew... Lugia,{NEWLINE}please, will you calm down?

strings.zh: 洛奇亚『Luuu……
strings.en: Lugia: Luuu...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『感谢你替我消耗洛奇亚啊！
strings.en: Lawrence: Thanks for{NEWLINE}wearing Lugia down for me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『吉尔露太你这家伙！{NEWLINE}把洛奇亚交出来！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Lawrence, you{NEWLINE}creep! Hand Lugia over!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『我说冠军大人,{NEWLINE}我可没义务听你的命令,{CLEAR}拜拜咯！
strings.en: Lawrence: Now, now, Champion,{NEWLINE}I’m under no obligation to{CLEAR}follow your orders. Bye-bye!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶……竟然让洛奇亚{NEWLINE}在我眼皮底下被抓走……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dammit... Lugia got{NEWLINE}caught right under my nose...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈哈哈,有特制球就是好！{NEWLINE}收服洛奇亚这样的精灵都能轻轻松松。
strings.en: Lawrence: Hahaha! Special Balls{NEWLINE}are the best! Even a Pokémon{CLEAR}like Lugia is a breeze to catch.

strings.zh: 彩月『冠军大人,吾等姐妹已经做好{NEWLINE}召唤洛奇亚的准备了,{CLEAR}请问要现在开始召唤仪式吗？
strings.en: Satsuki: Champion, we sisters are{NEWLINE}ready to summon Lugia. Shall we{CLEAR}begin the summoning ritual now?

strings.zh: 辛苦你了,{NEWLINE}若遇见空木先生的话,{CLEAR}请转告他多多关照。
strings.en: Thank you for your trouble. If you meet{NEWLINE}Mr. Elm, please give him my regards.
strings.notes: stray line (probably vanilla leftover of the Whirl Islands elder); speaker unknown.

strings.zh: 若是你不理睬的话,{NEWLINE}洛奇亚也暂时{CLEAR}不会来这里……{SCROLL}当你全部收集齐的时候,{CLEAR}再到这个地方来,{CLEAR}怎么样……
strings.en: If you pay no attention to it, Lugia{NEWLINE}won’t come here for a while...{CLEAR}How about coming back here once you’ve{CLEAR}collected them all...?
strings.notes: US 0125/8; modernised from US 0125#8 [D-2039 quality-trial-24: source-faithful correction.]

strings.zh: 不只是把洛奇亚召唤到了{NEWLINE}瀑布的前面,还成功地{CLEAR}让它收复成了自己的伙伴,{SCROLL}干得真是漂亮！{NEWLINE}我也已经{CLEAR}没有什么能说的了。{SCROLL}接下来的旅程,{NEWLINE}也要努力地继续走下去……
strings.en: Not only did you summon Lugia before{NEWLINE}the waterfall, you also made it your{CLEAR}partner. Splendidly done! I have{CLEAR}nothing more to say. On the journey{CLEAR}ahead, keep pressing onward...
strings.notes: US 0125/6; modernised from US 0125#6 | RV045: omission: US line dropped before the waterfall / made it your partner, changed 干得漂亮 and the closing wish

strings.zh: 如果这就是你的想法,{NEWLINE}我也{CLEAR}无话可说,{SCROLL}只是……想再次{NEWLINE}见到洛奇亚的话,{CLEAR}就在收集所有的东西以后,{CLEAR}在这个地方{CLEAR}见面怎么样……
strings.en: If that is what you believe, I have{NEWLINE}nothing more to say.{SCROLL}Still, if you wish to see Lugia once{NEWLINE}more, how about meeting here after{CLEAR}you’ve collected everything...?
strings.notes: US 0125/7; modernised from US 0125#7 [D-2040 quality-trial-24: restore collecting condition.] [D-2051 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 彩月『无妨。{NEWLINE}待冠军大人做好准备之后,{CLEAR}前来告知吾等姐妹即可。
strings.en: Satsuki: No matter. When you{NEWLINE}are ready, Champion, simply{CLEAR}come and tell us sisters.

strings.zh: 彩月『好的。当吾等的召唤之舞{NEWLINE}和您的海鸣铃铛产生共鸣时,{CLEAR}沉睡在瀑布深处的洛奇亚{CLEAR}就会再次现身。
strings.en: Satsuki: Very well. When our summoning{NEWLINE}dance resonates with your Tidal{CLEAR}Bell, Lugia, asleep deep behind the{CLEAR}waterfall, shall appear once more.

strings.zh: 彩月『古老传说中的海之守护神{NEWLINE}洛奇亚终于现身了……{CLEAR}尽管它曾经被火箭队收服,{CLEAR}但幸好有冠军大人您的保护,{CLEAR}洛奇亚才能再次以自由之身姿{CLEAR}出现在这海底洞穴。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Satsuki: Lugia, guardian of the{NEWLINE}sea from the ancient legends,{CLEAR}has appeared at last...{SCROLL}It was once captured by Team Rocket,{NEWLINE}but thanks to your protection,{CLEAR}Champion, Lugia can appear in this{CLEAR}undersea cave free once again.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 彩月『您是最有资格{NEWLINE}成为洛奇亚训练家的人,{CLEAR}请上前抚摸洛奇亚,{CLEAR}取得它正式的认可吧！
strings.en: Satsuki: You are the one most{NEWLINE}worthy of becoming Lugia’s Trainer.{CLEAR}Please step forward, touch Lugia{CLEAR}and receive its formal approval!

strings.zh: 洛奇亚向你点了点头。{NEWLINE}要收服它吗？
strings.en: Lugia nodded at you.{NEWLINE}Will you catch it?

strings.zh: 彩月『在深渊之下的瀑布前{NEWLINE}与洛奇亚展开了一场惊心动魄的决斗,{CLEAR}并取得了它的认可,{CLEAR}真不愧是冠军大人！{SCROLL}彩月『这样一来吾等传承了{NEWLINE}千百年的使命{CLEAR}也总算告一段落。{CLEAR}现在是时候要返回缘朱市了,{CLEAR}日后冠军大人如有时间,{CLEAR}欢迎再来歌舞连乘作客指导。
strings.en: Satsuki: Before the waterfall deep{NEWLINE}in the abyss, you fought a thrilling{CLEAR}duel with Lugia and won its approval.{CLEAR}Truly worthy of the Champion!{SCROLL}Satsuki: With this, the{NEWLINE}mission we have carried on for{CLEAR}centuries is at last fulfilled.{SCROLL}It is time for us to return to Ecruteak{NEWLINE}City. Champion, whenever you have time,{CLEAR}you are welcome to visit the Dance{CLEAR}Theater and give us your guidance.

strings.zh: 小桃『冠军大人,{NEWLINE}召唤洛奇亚的舞蹈已经准备完毕。{CLEAR}您如果想要开始召唤仪式的话,{CLEAR}可以告诉彩月大姐。
strings.en: Momo: Champion, the dance to{NEWLINE}summon Lugia is ready. If you wish{CLEAR}to begin the summoning ritual,{CLEAR}please tell Big Sister Satsuki.

strings.zh: 玉绪『冠军大人,{NEWLINE}召唤洛奇亚的舞蹈已经准备完毕。{CLEAR}您如果想要开始召唤仪式的话,{CLEAR}可以告诉彩月大姐。
strings.en: Tamao: Champion, the dance to{NEWLINE}summon Lugia is ready. If you wish{CLEAR}to begin the summoning ritual,{CLEAR}please tell Big Sister Satsuki.

strings.zh: 小桃『洛奇亚已经现身,{NEWLINE}请冠军大人上前收服吧。
strings.en: Momo: Lugia has appeared. Please{NEWLINE}step forward and catch it, Champion.

strings.zh: 玉绪『洛奇亚已经现身,{NEWLINE}请冠军大人上前收服吧。
strings.en: Tamao: Lugia has appeared. Please{NEWLINE}step forward and catch it, Champion.

strings.zh: 小梅『洛奇亚已经现身,{NEWLINE}请冠军大人上前收服吧。
strings.en: Koume: Lugia has appeared. Please{NEWLINE}step forward and catch it, Champion.

strings.zh: 小梅『冠军大人,{NEWLINE}召唤洛奇亚的舞蹈已经准备完毕。{CLEAR}您如果想要开始召唤仪式的话,{CLEAR}可以告诉彩月大姐。
strings.en: Koume: Champion, the dance to{NEWLINE}summon Lugia is ready. If you wish{CLEAR}to begin the summoning ritual,{CLEAR}please tell Big Sister Satsuki.

strings.zh: 吔『我们已经准备好跳舞了,{NEWLINE}冠军大人要开始召唤洛奇亚的话,{CLEAR}跟彩月大姐说一声就可以了。
strings.en: Sakura: We’re all set to dance! If{NEWLINE}you want to start summoning Lugia,{CLEAR}Champion, just tell Big Sis Satsuki.

strings.zh: 吔『那就是洛奇亚吗？好大呀！
strings.en: Sakura: So that’s Lugia? It’s huge!

strings.zh: 彩月『洛奇亚已经现身,{NEWLINE}请冠军大人上前收服吧。
strings.en: Satsuki: Lugia has appeared. Please{NEWLINE}step forward and catch it, Champion.
